summary: Hickenlooper cosponsored the 2025 Antisemitism Awareness Act, directing the Education Department to use the IHRA definition in campus investigations, and in July 2025 voted with the Republican majority to defeat two resolutions that would have partially blocked military aid to Israel. His October 2025 ceasefire statement paired humanitarian aid for Palestinians with security for Israelis, and Vote for Peace opposes his candidacy. A co-signed letter on West Bank settler violence does not offset this legislative record.
